meta.counter: one issuer to one recipient every interval_days, Member, proximity, connectivity 1; c is the sim's decayed pair counter before each Ember (pair_contribution_per_day recurrence, no RNG)
meta.penalties: amount is positive and subtracted (§5.1 penalty term); the sim has no penalties, so their float terms are computed here with the sim's LAM

tolerance.reputation: abs(ts - py) <= sum over terms of (decay_rel * |term| + weight_abs + 1e-6)

meta.units: decimal quantities as strings (exact at REP_SCALE); expected values float64
